summary: Sound Financial Bancorp filed an 8-K (Items 2.02, 8.01, 9.01) on April 28, 2026, reporting Q1 2026 earnings and declaring a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.21 per share, payable May 26, 2026 to holders of record May 11, 2026. No special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, activist campaign, spin-off, restructuring, or delisting is described; this is a routine current report of financial results and a standard dividend declaration. The filing discloses no material definitive agreement, no change in control, and no board recommendation regarding a transaction. Accordingly, this filing does not constitute a special situation and is classified as 'None'.
